title: Ten Thousand Times Ten Thousand
description: Ten Thousand Times Ten Thousand in Tonic Solfa to ALFORD: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: Henry Alford’s words first appeared in 1867. John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune ALFORD in 1875.
underlay: Ten thou-sand times ten thou-sand In spark-ling rai-ment bright, The ar-mies of the ran-somed saints Throng up the steeps of light: ’Tis fin-ished, all is fin-ished, Their fight with death and_ sin: Fling o-pen wide the gold-en gates, And let the vic-tors in.

lines: The armies of the ransomed saints
Throng up the steeps of light:
Their fight with death and sin:
Fling open wide the golden gates,
Fills all the earth and sky!
What ringing of a thousand harps
And all its tribes were made;
O joy, for all its former woes
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle,
That brimmed with tears of late,
